hints.title: Schema Header Renaming
hints.text: Table headers often need to be standardized to conform with naming conventions. Which method accepts a dictionary mapping current names to replacement names?

hints.title: Column Mapping Dictionary
hints.text: The rename method accepts a columns parameter with key-value pairs matching old labels to new labels.

hints.title: Mapped Column Definition
hints.text: Map id to student_id, first_name to first_name, last_name to last_name, and age to age_in_years in the rename call.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: C: number of columns in DataFrame (fixed schema)
complexity.notes: Constant-time index label replacement without modifying underlying data blocks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding the entire DataFrame with a newly allocated constructor copies column values unnecessarily.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Renaming Index objects produces a lightweight metadata view.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Idiomatic use of DataFrame.rename with dictionary mapping preserving order and existing datatypes.
